available_enums.name: variant
available_enums.description: used for changing the font sizes

components.title: Scenes
components.description: standalone, no siblings

components.name: StatCounter
components.description: Centered animated metric counter with a short 2-3 word label below it
components.instructions: Use for large numbers(at least 2 digit), metric, or KPI with or without prefix/suffix eg. 1240, 500$, 500K, 500M

components.name: AnimatedText

llmSchema.name: text
llmSchema.hint: Use {} around text that should be highlighted. Example: "We build {great software}"

components.description: Reveals a word or a text
components.instructions:
- Use splitBy="char", "word", or "line" based on how the text should be revealed.
- Use splitBy="char" for character-by-character reveals.
- Use splitBy="word" for sequential word reveals and "line" for grouped multi-line reveals.
- When using splitBy="line", define line breaks with "\n".
- Optionally wrap words in {} to highlight or emphasize specific parts of the text.
components.celExpression:
max(
  30,
  max(0, segmentCount(props.animatedtext.text, props.animatedtext.splitBy) - 1) * props.animatedtext.staggerDelay
  + props.animatedtext.duration
  + (props.animatedtext.highlightedTextAnimation != "none" ? props.animatedtext.duration : 0)
  + (props.animatedtext.exitAnimation != "none" ? props.animatedtext.exitDuration : 0)
)

components.name: TextHookStagger
components.description: Reveals a short hook or intro bold phrase word-by-word with animated last word

components.name: Typewriter
components.description: Character-by-character typewriter effect
components.instructions: Use for dramatic reveals or code/terminal effects.

components.name: WordCycle
components.description: Rotates through words on a bold background
components.instructions: Use for emphasis words, or highlighting multiple key points.

components.name: TextWithWordCycle
components.description: Static text with cycling highlighted words at the end
components.instructions: Use for dynamic taglines like "We build amazing [software/products/solutions]"

components.name: TextLeadStagger
components.celExpression: ((50 + max(0, segmentCount(props.textleadstagger.text, "word") - 2) * 5 + max(0, segmentCount(props.textleadstagger.text, "word") - 1) * 4) * 100) / max(25, props.textleadstagger.speed)
components.description: First word starts enlarged and then settles down. The remaining words enter in a stagger and exit in stagger.
components.instructions: Do not use it more than once

components.name: ProblemHeadline
components.description: A short headline scene for concise text with brush paint animation on the text
components.instructions: Use it to show the main problem, key pain point, or an important headline from the script.

components.name: TextCardStack
components.description: Displays problem or solution statements as playful stacked cards
components.instructions: Best for short descriptive phrases; avoid very brief (one- or two-word) content.

components.name: ProblemCollagePills
components.description: Starts with one typed pill in the center, then zooms out into a scattered field of typing data pills.
components.instructions: Best used to show problems, scattered data, fragmented workflows, multiple blockers, or disconnected context. Infer exactly 7 short signals from the script even if not explicitly stated.

components.name: IntroText

llmSchema.name: intro_body
llmSchema.hint: Main reveal text shown below the label

components.description: Starts with a centered intro label, then settles it upward while the main text reveals word-by-word below.
components.instructions: Use this before introducing a brand logo or product

components.name: TextWithMediaScene
components.description: Displays text with a image or video.
components.instructions: One liner text with animated text or word cycle. Choose one of the filler component and its props in textComponentProps: animatedtext, or textwithwordcycle.

components.name: MultiImageStack

llmSchema.name: cyclingWords
llmSchema.hint: The features to highlight per image

llmSchema.name: images
llmSchema.hint: The images of each feature under a usecase

components.description: A centered TextWithWordCycle headline above a stacked images revealing one by one with word cycle.
components.instructions: use it to show multi features of a usecase with product images. Takes around 170 frames for 3 images.

components.name: ProblemCollage

llmSchema.name: images
llmSchema.hint: Provide 5 default images of size 800x400 that user can change later

components.description: Centered problem statement with screenshots that fly in around it as a scattered collage
components.instructions: Best used to show data scattered across tools, fragmentation, multiple issues kind of problems. Takes around **66 frames** to complete

components.name: LogoShowcase

llmSchema.name: text
llmSchema.hint: caption to show below the icons

components.description: Row of brand logos + caption.
components.instructions: Use for integrations, tech stack, partners, brands. eg. logos=["url1", "url2"], text="caption text".
components.celExpression: 10 + max(min(1, segmentCount(props.animatedtext.text, props.animatedtext.splitBy)) * (max(0, segmentCount(props.animatedtext.text, props.animatedtext.splitBy) - 1) * 25 + 20), 5 + max(0, size(props.logos) - 1) * 5 + 12)

components.name: LogoWithBrandName
components.description: Logo + brand name reveal.

components.name: LogoWithCTA
components.description: Logo icon and brand name reveal with a CTA text below that.

components.name: IconShowcase

llmSchema.name: text
llmSchema.hint: caption to show below the icons

components.description: Row of rotating brand icons + caption.
components.instructions: Use for integrations, tech stack, partners, brands. eg. icons={["shopify", "midjourney", "openai"]}, text="caption text".
components.celExpression: 10 + max(0, size(props.icons) - 1) * 5 + 10 + min(1, segmentCount(props.animatedtext.text, props.animatedtext.splitBy)) * (5 + max(0, segmentCount(props.animatedtext.text, props.animatedtext.splitBy) - 1) * 25 + 20)

components.name: PillCarousel

fields.name: icon
fields.hint: brand or generic icon name that best represet the text

components.description: A headline with a carousel of items below, each showing text and an icon (choose an icon name that represents the text) as a pill
components.instructions: Use for features, industries, use cases, capabilities, or categories. ~25 frames per item; minimum 3 items.

components.name: MediaWithFeatures
components.description: Shows a large product image or video with stacked feature cards on the top-right. Each feature card contains an icon and a short label revealed in staggered animation

components.name: AnimatedMedia
components.description: An animated media element (image or video) with text overlay.

llmSchema.name: text
llmSchema.hint: one liner text to specity what feature is being demonstrated

components.name: TimelineCardStack
components.description: Timeline-style vertical sequence of feature cards. One card centers at a time, then hands off to the next with a dashed connector.
components.instructions: use it to show a list of features or emphasis words
